account.changeEmailBody: We'll send a confirmation link to the new address. It only becomes your sign-in email once you follow that link.
account.emailChangeSent: Check your new inbox for a confirmation link.
account.handleHint: Letters, digits, “_” and “-”. Must be unique.
account.leaveDesc: Sign out on this device, or close the account for good.
account.noEmail: No email address on this account.
account.signOutConfirm: Sign out of {hub}? Anything you have downloaded stays on this device.
account.title: Account

appearance.accentProfileHint: Your color is what your name and your profile wear wherever other people see them.
appearance.customColourHint: Pick any color - buttons, highlights and the background tint follow it.
appearance.languageHint: Sets the language your server writes in — its emails, and the messages it sends back to this app.

mode.artworkHint: Follows the cover that is playing.

appearance.modeHint: Anything but Steady pauses while the tab is in the background, and holds still if you have asked your system for reduced motion.
appearance.nameAccent: Show my name in my color
appearance.nameAccentHint: Wherever your name appears to other people.
appearance.paletteHint: Two to six colors. Fade moves between them; Gradient blends them.
appearance.showProfileAccents: Let profiles use their own colors
appearance.showProfileAccentsHint: When someone has set a color, their profile page wears it while you are on it.
appearance.speedHint: How quickly it moves. Even the fastest takes about a minute to come round.
appearance.title: Appearance

discord.desc: Linking and unlinking Discord happens on the Chordia website.
discord.label: Discord

lastfm.desc: Scrobble your plays to Last.fm automatically.
lastfm.label: Last.fm
lastfm.opensBrowser: Connecting opens Last.fm in your browser. Come back and refresh when it is done.

data.body: Download everything Chordia stores about you, or permanently delete your account and all its data.
data.deleteAccountConfirm: Permanently delete your account and everything in it, including your listening history, playlists, libraries, and friends? This cannot be undone.
data.deleteFailedBody: Could not delete your account right now. Please try again.
data.exportFailedBody: Could not export your data right now. Please try again.
data.exportReady: Your export is ready to save or send on.
data.title: Your data

close.desc: Chordia can keep playing in the background. Closing quits instead if your desktop has no tray.
close.title: When you close the window

presence.artworkDesc: Album art follows any cover you have overridden for the track or album in your library.
presence.badgeDesc: The small icon over the artwork. Needs artwork to sit on.
presence.desc: Puts the current track on your Discord profile. Needs Discord running on this computer. Off unless you turn it on.
presence.label: Show what I'm listening to
presence.previewIdle: Play something to see how your status will read.
presence.title: Discord

vars.globalPlays: How many times everyone on this server has played it
vars.plays: How many times you've played it in that window
vars.rank: Where it ranks among your most played in that window
vars.title: Track title

presence.varsDesc: Click one to insert it where your cursor is. Anything that turns out to be empty is removed along with the punctuation around it.
presence.whenPausedDesc: Discord adds a time counter of its own to a paused song, counting up from when the status was last updated. It isn't the song's position or its length, and there is no way to turn it off.

updates.desc: Looks for a new version every few hours. Nothing installs until you say so, so it will never interrupt what you're playing.
updates.label: Check for new versions
updates.title: Updates

downloads.serverNote: Music libraries themselves are added and organized on your Chordia library server, not here. Saving downloads to a custom folder (with your own path + organization layout) is coming to the desktop app.

thisDevice.description: Downloaded songs are stored on this device and play without a connection.
thisDevice.empty: Use the Download action on any track or album.
thisDevice.title: This device (browser storage)

downloads.title: Downloads

import.body: Bring your listening history from Spotify or Last.fm. Plays that match music in your libraries are linked to it; everything else is kept with its original text and matches later if that music arrives.

errors.internal: Something went wrong while importing. Try again.
errors.interrupted: The import was interrupted before it finished. Upload the file again; rows already imported are recognized and never doubled.
errors.malformed: The file could not be read all the way through. Export it again and retry.
errors.unrecognized: This file does not look like a Spotify or Last.fm export.

import.hint: Accepts a Spotify extended streaming history (.json) or a Last.fm export (.csv), up to 200 MB. Uploading the same file twice never duplicates plays.
import.startInBrowser: Uploading an export file needs the Chordia website. Jobs you start there show their progress here.
import.title: Import listening history
import.tooLarge: That file is over 64 MB. Split the export and upload the parts one at a time; nothing is counted twice.
import.uploadFailed: Could not start the import. Try again.

playerBar.help: Choose which controls sit at the right of the player bar, and in what order.
playerBar.title: Now playing bar

sidebar.empty: Nothing pinned yet. Pin an album, artist or playlist and it will show up here.
sidebar.help: Drag to reorder the top of your sidebar, and untick anything you would rather not see. Hidden entries stay reachable from search and keyboard shortcuts.
sidebar.title: Sidebar

plan.opensInBrowser: Payment happens on the Chordia website, in your browser.
plan.selfHosted: This is a self-hosted Chordia server, so there is nothing to buy here. Every feature is available to every account.
plan.title: Plan

autoplay.desc: Keep playing similar music when the queue ends.
autoplay.label: Autoplay

crossfade.desc: Overlap and blend the end of each track into the next. Measured in seconds.
crossfade.label: Crossfade

playback.equalizerDesc: Shape the sound with a parametric equalizer.

output.desc: Where sound comes out. Your browser asks which device to allow, so the name only appears after you pick it.
output.label: Output device

preload.desc: How many upcoming queue tracks to download ahead of time, for instant gap-free playback. Higher uses more data.
preload.label: Preload next tracks

playback.storageDesc: Music saved on this device, and the room it takes.
playback.title: Playback

activityVisibility.desc: Who can see your recent plays and compare taste with you.
activityVisibility.label: Listening activity

emailNotifications.desc: Get an email for friend requests and other account activity.
emailNotifications.label: Email notifications

followedArtistsVisibility.desc: Who can see the artists you follow.
followedArtistsVisibility.label: Followed artists

followersVisibility.desc: Who can see the accounts that follow you.
followersVisibility.label: Followers list

followingVisibility.desc: Who can see the accounts you follow.
followingVisibility.label: Following list

activity.desc: What Chordia records as you listen.
activity.title: Activity

audience.desc: Who your listening is visible to.
audience.title: Who can see what

openToFollows.desc: When off, nobody new can follow you. Existing followers stay.
openToFollows.label: Let people follow me

playlistsVisibility.desc: Who can see your public playlists on your profile. Each playlist still opts in separately.
playlistsVisibility.label: Playlists

profileVisibility.desc: Who can open your profile at all. Everything below is only reachable once this lets someone through.
profileVisibility.label: Profile

scrobble.desc: Record what you play for your stats and Rotation.
scrobble.label: Scrobble listens

profile.bannerHint: A wide image across the top of your profile.
profile.bioPlaceholder: A line or two about what you listen to.
profile.desc: What people see when they open your profile.
profile.linksHint: Up to 8. Each must be a full https:// address.
profile.title: Profile

timezone.description: Used to place listening activity on your local calendar. Follow this device leaves the choice to each client.
timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.noMatches: No time zones match your search

sections.account: Profile, email, and closing your account
sections.appearance: Color, language, and where the app opens
sections.data: Export your data, import your history
sections.plan: Your plan and what it includes
sections.privacy: Scrobbling, and who can see what

password.lockoutNote: Wrong attempts here count towards the same limit as signing in, so repeated misses will temporarily lock sign-in too.
password.revokeOthersDesc: Recommended if you're changing it because someone else may know it. This device stays signed in.
password.storedHint: Chordia only ever stores a one-way hash of your password. Nobody, including us, can show it to you. If you've forgotten it, reset it by email instead.
password.title: Password

setPassword.body: This account signs in with Discord. Set a password to be able to sign in with your email address as well.
setPassword.needsVerifiedEmail: Verify your email address first. The link to set a password has to go somewhere you've confirmed you own.
setPassword.sent: Check your inbox for a link to set your password.
setPassword.title: Set a password

sessions.body: Where you're signed in. Revoke any device you don't recognize.
sessions.signOutEverywhereConfirm: Sign out of all devices? You'll need to sign in again.
sessions.title: Devices & sessions

startup.desc: Where Chordia opens when you sign in.
startup.title: Startup

twoFactor.addHint: Add a second factor (an authenticator app) for extra account security.
twoFactor.enabledHint: 2FA is enabled. To turn it off, enter a current code or a recovery code.
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: 2FA is on. Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your authenticator.
twoFactor.scanHint: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication

verifyEmail.body: We sent a verification link to your email. Didn't get it? Resend it below.
verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
